pages.text: If you've succeeded in the Demesnes Ritual, you can right-click on any Demesne Beacon to unlock perks. The center four start unlocked; choosing a perk unlocks adjacent perks. Some can be unlocked repeatedly to upgrade their effect. But beware: perk selections are permanent, and you can only select up to 10 of them!
Most perks are simple enough that they can be explained in the tooltips when you hover over them. Certain ones require further explanation though, so read on if you want to know more about them.
